next.reason: CHANGED: 00, 04, 05 and WRITE/REWRITE 02 keep their meaning (§2023:9.1.13.2 GR1, GR3, GR4; GR2 c "For a REWRITE or WRITE statement, the record just written created a duplicate key value for at least one alternate record key for which duplicates are allowed"). READ 02 narrows: 1985 sets 02 for any READ when "the key value for the current key of reference is equal to the value of the same key in the next record within the current key of reference" (§1985:IX.1.3.4), which covers a random READ by an alternate key with duplicates (it returns the first of the duplicates, §1985:IX.4.5.4 GR17); 2023 sets 02 only "For a READ statement with the NEXT phrase specified or implied" (§2023:9.1.13.2 GR2) and only when "an indexed file is being sequentially accessed, the key of reference is an alternate record key" (§2023:14.9.30.4 GR27), so that random READ now completes with 00. PREVIOUS and DELETE FILE 05 are 2023-only syntax.
